**Implementation note:** Turtle ATR units. V7 (vol-ratio lot scaling) is the wired relative.

## Description

Set units inversely to ATR or distance to a stop so each trade targets a defined dollar risk.

## Where it may fit

Strategies with explicit price stops across instruments with different volatility.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs, futures, FX and CTA strategies.

## Required data

OHLC bars, ATR, account equity, stop distance, contract multiplier, tick size and risk budget.

## Caveats

Gaps and stop slippage can exceed the planned risk; ATR is backward-looking.
